title: Movies to Watch Before GTA 6: IGN's Curated Watchlist
description: Get ready for GTA 6 with IGN Games' curated list of movies to watch, featuring classic films heading to Regal Cinemas over the coming week to build the ultimate hype.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Preparing for GTA 6: The Ultimate Pre-Launch Movie Watchlist

As the gaming community eagerly counts down to the release of *GTA 6*, fans are constantly looking for ways to immerse themselves in the criminal underworld and cinematic vibes that Rockstar Games is famous for. Recently, gaming media outlet IGN Games compiled a specialized list of movies to watch before diving into the upcoming open-world epic. This curated guide features a selection of classic films, including several that will be screened at Regal Cinemas over the course of the next week.

### The Cinematic Roots of Open-World Crimes

Rockstar's *Grand Theft Auto* franchise has always worn its cinematic influences on its sleeve. From the 1980s neon-soaked aesthetic of *Vice City* to the Hollywood satire of *GTA 5*, the series draws heavily from classic crime dramas, action thrillers, and satirical masterpieces. By highlighting these films, IGN's list provides a fascinating cultural bridge for players who want to explore the cinematic foundations that inspire modern gaming's biggest blockbusters.

According to IGN Games, the selected movies span various eras and styles. While many of these classics are easily accessible for a cozy movie night at home, the inclusion of special screenings at Regal Cinemas gives enthusiasts a chance to experience these influential stories on the big screen. Whether you are revisiting tales of high-stakes heists, gritty underworld dramas, or chaotic road-trip adventures, viewing these films offers a brilliant parallel to the chaotic energy expected in the next installment of the franchise.

### Building the Anticipation

While trailers have given us a glimpse of the modern, social-media-obsessed Florida-inspired setting of *GTA 6*, watching these curated films is a great way to occupy the waiting period. It allows players to appreciate the storytelling tropes, character dynamics, and atmospheric world-building that influence the developers at Rockstar. As we draw closer to the game's launch, diving into these cinematic masterpieces is an entertaining way to prep for the streets of Vice City.

## Editor's Take

IGN's movie watchlist might not contain direct gameplay details for *GTA 6*, but it brilliantly taps into the pop-culture DNA of the franchise. Taking the time to watch these classics is a fun, immersive way to build anticipation and appreciate the artistic inspirations behind Rockstar's legendary open-world design.
